description: Single-phase DIN-rail energy meter with RS485: voltage, current, power, power factor, frequency and import/export energy
source: Chint, DDSU666 single-phase electronic energy meter (DIN-rail) manuals ZTY0.464.922 and ZTY0.464.1036, appendix A (MODBUS-RTU)

sources.title: DDSU666.004.0006 type single phase electronic energy meter (DIN-Rail), Operation manual

notes: Function codes 03 (read) and 10 (write multiple registers). The meter ships with the DL/T 645-2007 protocol: write 2 to the Protocol register to switch to Modbus-RTU.
Floats are IEEE 754 single precision, high word first. Values are on the secondary side and already in engineering units.
Frame format: 8 data bits and no parity; the manual's appendix says two stop bits ('other formats can be customized'), while the display example shows one stop bit. The map uses one stop bit.
The baud rate table lists 2400, 4800 and 9600; the text also mentions 1200.
